title: SOAP-Bubbles: Structured Weight Uncertainty for Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.23357v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Structured weight-uncertainty can improve many aspects of deep learning, but it remains costly to estimate and difficult to implement. Here, we show that these issues can be addressed by adapting the SOAP optimizer. Our key idea is to run IVON, an existing diagonal-covariance variational method, in the eigenspace of SOAP's preconditioner and then use the preconditioner to transform the diagonal estimate into a non-diagonal covariance. The resulting method has costs similar to those of SOAP and requires no drastic changes to training pipelines. We call the posteriors obtained in this way SOAP-Bubbles and our new optimizer Eigenspace-VON (EVON). We show that, for logistic regression, EVON can match the full Gaussian covariance and that, for language model pretraining, it yields significantly better results than existing diagonal-covariance methods. translated_title: SOAP-Bubbles：面向神经网络的结构化权重不确定性
translated_abstract: 结构化权重不确定性可以改善深度学习的许多方面，但其估计成本高昂且难以实现。本文证明这些问题可以通过改造SOAP优化器来解决。我们的核心思想是在SOAP预条件子的特征空间中运行IVON（一种现有的对角协方差变分方法），然后利用该预条件子将对角估计转换为非对角协方差。所得到的方法成本与SOAP相近，且无需对训练流程进行大幅改动。我们将以这种方式获得的后验称为SOAP-Bubbles，并将我们的新优化器命名为Eigenspace-VON（EVON）。我们表明，对于逻辑回归任务，EVON能够达到完整高斯协方差的效果；对于语言模型预训练，其结果显著优于现有的对角协方差方法。我们的工作使得为深度学习估计更具表达力的后验分布变得更加容易。
tldr: 本文提出新优化器EVON，通过在SOAP预条件子的特征空间中运行IVON并将对角协方差转换为非对角协方差，以接近SOAP的成本实现了结构化权重不确定性估计，在语言模型预训练中显著优于现有对角协方差方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EVON, a new optimizer that runs IVON in the eigenspace of SOAP's preconditioner and transforms the diagonal covariance estimate into a non-diagonal covariance, enabling structured weight uncertainty estimation at costs similar to SOAP and achieving significantly better language model pretraining results than existing diagonal-covariance methods.
